mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, knowledge_id, file_id, doc_name, doc_type, source_type, source_url, content_hash, chunk_count, process_status, process_attempt, process_error, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, del_flag
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET process_status = 'processing', process_error = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, process_deadline = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{timeoutSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND process_status = 'pending' AND process_attempt = #{attempt} AND process_deadline > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET process_status = 'pending', process_attempt = #{attempt}, process_error = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, process_deadline = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{timeoutSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND process_status = #{expectedStatus} AND (process_status = 'failed' OR process_attempt IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, process_attempt AS attempt FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE del_flag = 0 AND process_status IN ('pending', 'processing') AND process_attempt IS NOT NULL AND process_deadline <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY process_deadline, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET process_status = 'failed', process_error = 'knowledge.document.processing.interrupted', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND process_attempt = #{attempt} AND del_flag = 0 AND process_status IN ('pending', 'processing') AND process_deadline <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
